name: @danypops/pi-ipv4-fallback
description: Probes IPv6 reachability once at pi startup and prefers IPv4 for the whole process if it's broken (e.g. VPNs that blackhole IPv6 instead of rejecting it), fixing opaque OAuth/network timeouts like the Vertex AI ADC token fetch.
